subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should this PR require a redacted live Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection smoke before merge, or may maintainers accept the credential gap for this narrow source-level fix?
rationale: The contributor cannot run the external API smoke without a key, while repository policy expects live proof for external API behavior when feasible.

options.title: Require or provide live smoke
options.body: A maintainer or contributor supplies redacted live endpoint-detection output showing the coding endpoint selected after this change before merge.

options.title: Accept the credential gap
options.body: Maintainers explicitly accept the source-level fix plus linked issue evidence as sufficient for this narrow probe-header change.

options.title: Choose another candidate PR
options.body: Maintainers select a sibling closing PR as the canonical landing path and leave this PR pending or close it after that fix merges.

recommendation.title: Require or provide live smoke
recommendation.body: A maintainer or contributor supplies redacted live endpoint-detection output showing the coding endpoint selected after this change before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and later expanded the Z.AI endpoint-detection/provider behavior that this proof decision affects.
